name: ai-humanizer
description: Detects and removes AI writing patterns, rewriting text to sound natural and human.

displayDescription.en: Detects 24 AI writing patterns and 500+ AI vocabulary terms, analyzes burstiness and vocabulary diversity, then rewrites text into natural human expression.
displayDescription.zh: 识别24种AI写作模式与500+词汇，统计突发性与多样性，重写为自然真实的人类表达，彻底消除机器味。
